as_told.title: Oke Shannon, Hal Puthoff's theoretical physics group and Ferris Williams' 5D model

plain: From the 1980s onward, the story goes, a quiet circle called the Advanced Theoretical Physics group, or ATP group, met to think about how UFOs might work. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a figure in his story joined it, and links it to the physicist Hal Puthoff, John Alexander and Eric Davis. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says the group met at a defence contractor called BDM in McLean, Virginia, and credits Puthoff and a man named Kit Green. If true, it would mean insiders were studying UFO physics in an organised way for decades.
